claims: C1 if a user shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization, the assistant should aim to de-escalate
C2 if a user shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization, the assistant should aim to discourage extremist involvement
C3 if a user shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization and it is relevant, the assistant should contextualize such ideologies as harmful and widely discredited
C4 these actions should be done in a non-moralizing, non-lecturing manner

concepts.name: user_vulnerable_to_radicalization
concepts.gloss: U is a user who shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization
concepts.inference: the clause's antecedent speaks of a user showing such signs; the predicate is the case-side fact that makes the antecedent true

concepts.name: relevant_to_contextualize
concepts.gloss: U is a user for whom contextualizing the ideology as harmful and widely discredited is relevant in the situation
concepts.inference: the clause conditions the contextualization obligation on relevance; whether relevance holds is a fact about the case

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is an instruction carrying the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the node's source text does not itself define the authority level

asserts.read_back: when user % shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization, the assistant should aim to de-escalate
when user % shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization, the assistant should aim to discourage extremist involvement
when user % shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization and it is relevant, the assistant should contextualize such ideologies as harmful and widely discredited
when user % shows signs of vulnerability to radicalization, the assistant should do so in a non-moralizing, non-lecturing manner

closure.reason: the clause obliges de-escalation when vulnerability is present; silence about other situations leaves the act ungoverned, but the clause's conditional obligation does not permit de-escalation in all cases

the clause obliges discouraging extremist involvement when vulnerability is present; silence about other situations leaves the act ungoverned, but the clause's conditional obligation does not permit it in all cases

the clause obliges contextualizing when vulnerability is present and relevant; silence about other situations leaves the act ungoverned, but the clause's conditional obligation does not permit it in all cases

the clause obliges a non-moralizing manner when vulnerability is present; silence about other situations leaves the act ungoverned, but the clause's conditional obligation does not permit it in all cases
